resultJson.title: Add Option/Try conversion helpers and a ParseError demo
resultJson.body:
Adds a `tryoption` sample showing conversions between `Option` and `Try` in both directions: `optionToTry` (caller supplies the exception for `None`), `tryToOption`, and `tryFailureToOption`.

The sample includes a `ParseError` enum with a `NotANumber` case, so failures can be pattern-matched instead of parsed from text. A `parseInt` example and a `tryOptionDemo` main show it in use.

This is the `Try` version of the sample requested in the task prompt, which asked for the same sample as the `either` task, adapted to `Try`. The diff also adds a `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` progress log.
